title: AspectCoverage
description: Per-aspect evidence coverage for one cell type, written by assess-coverage and updated by free-search. Drives the escalation ladder (thin/absent aspects get a free search) and the synthesizer's honesty contract (an aspect still absent after free search MUST render as 'No evidence found in traversed literature.').

assessed_from.description: Path of the all_summaries.json this assessment was made over.

aspects.description: One entry per query_decomposition aspect. The five aspect names are the shared contract with synthesis.

status.description: 'covered' = enough in-scope evidence; 'thin' = some but not enough; 'absent' = none yet; 'absent_after_free_search' = the free-search rung also returned nothing relevant — the report section must state that honestly.

in_scope_items.description: Evidence items whose source context matches the decomposition scope.

off_scope_only.description: True when the aspect has evidence but all of it is off-scope (different species/stage/tissue). Off-scope evidence is usable with the mismatch stated; it does not count as covered.
